search_text: published ZDI-14-163 ZDI-CAN-2260 (0Day) Rocket Servergraph Admin Center for TSM fileRequestorServlet readDataFile Command Information Disclosure Vulnerability 2014-06-02 CVE-2014-3914 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2014-3914 7.8 ['Rocket Software'] ['Rocket Servergraph'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to obtain sensitive information on vulnerable installations of Rocket Servergraph Admin Center for Tivoli Storage Manager. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the fileRequestServlet servlet. This servlet is vulnerable to a directory traversal vulnerability when processing readDataFile commands. A remote attacker can leverage this vulnerability to disclose credentials and possibly leverage this situation to achieve remote code execution. This vulnerability is being disclosed publicly without a patch in accordance with the ZDI vulnerability disclosure policy on lack of vendor response.
